name: cover
prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Create ONE finished children's coloring-book sheet, portrait 1024 x 1536. Input image is the chapter cover and is the sole character/composition reference. Redraw its scene as VERY SIMPLE black outline art on a completely pure white page for a FOUR-YEAR-OLD using thick crayons. Keep Papa hedgehog with shoulder satchel holding small PinPin's paw, PinPin pointing with his free paw, and the friendly floppy-eared curled-tail dog walking behind. All three characters fully visible, friendly recognizable faces, correct paws and clear silhouettes. Enlarge them to occupy most of the page. REMOVE EVERY LETTER AND ALL TITLE TEXT. Keep only two simple tree trunks, a few very large leaves and one simple path line; eliminate distant forest, grass texture and small flowers. Bold smooth uniform BLACK contours, enclosed large WHITE colorable regions. Hedgehog quills are one simple zigzag outer silhouette with at most six large inner quill shapes, not many individual needles. Dog coat is smooth broad white shapes, no fur strokes. White eyes with tiny black pupils, noses as outlined white ovals. Absolutely no gray, shading, gradients, hatching, stippling, shadows, solid dark fur, color, text, frames, panels, or decorative patterns. Open uncluttered white background and generous print margin. Single sheet, not a collage.

review.notes: Bold simple contours, all three characters fully visible, large white regions, no lettering or shading; tiny filled pupils/nose details only.
